name: Sleek Silver Metal Frame Full-Length Floor Mirror
description: Check out your daily outfits in style! This modern, minimalist full-length dressing mirror features a gorgeous, ultra-thin brushed silver metal frame that seamlessly coordinates with any bedroom or entryway decor. Designed with an adjustable built-in easel stand on the back, it stands completely free and rock-solid without needing any wall drilling or hardware. It provides a crystal-clear, true-to-reflection image with zero distortion. Super lightweight and effortless to move around whenever you want to refresh your room layout!
contact_note: The back easel support legs fold completely flat in seconds, making it incredibly slim and easy to fit inside any standard car for a quick pickup!
meta_description: Pre-owned sleek full-length floor mirror with a brushed silver thin metal frame and built-in folding easel stand. Ideal for bedrooms or apartments.
name_zh: 现代银色窄边全身落地穿衣镜
description_zh: 小户型及卧室标配的极简窄边全身镜！带有拉丝银色/铬色金属质感边框，时尚又百搭。自带人字后支架（Easel stand），无需在墙上钻孔即可稳固站立。采用高清防爆镜面，反射真实不失真。整体非常轻便，后支架可以完全折叠成纯平面，即使普通轿车也能轻松运走，搬家或挪动位置毫不费力。
